purpose: Real molecular inputs for AI Scientist planning tests. Nothing here is a ChemDFT calculation or a result: coordinates are the source's own, preserved byte for byte (SDF) or constructed once from one cited constant (H2).

molecules.title: Hydrogen molecule

source.authority: NIST Chemistry WebBook, SRD 69: Constants of diatomic molecules (compiled by K. P. Huber and G. H. Herzberg, data through 1976)
source.construction: Two H atoms on the z axis, centred at the origin, at z = -r_e/2 and +r_e/2 (+/-0.37072 Angstrom). The electronic state is declared in the XYZ comment line (charge 0, multiplicity 1). PubChem has no 3D conformer record for H2 (PUG REST returned 404 on 2026-10-17).

molecules.reuse_basis: A single published numerical constant, cited; the coordinates are constructed here.

expected.note: The PubChem conformer differs from the experimental equilibrium geometry (O-H 0.9572 A, H-O-H 104.52 degrees, as used by the repository's own water test geometry); it is a computed model and is labelled as such.
